propositions: A contributor comment containing `recheck-review` must re-trigger LLM-Review on coverage-gap verdicts but refuse to re-review any actual-finding BLOCK, including the merge-change variant.

The eligibility check must read the bot's current-revision vote message tag from Gerrit's authoritative state (not contributor input), classify tag stems including in-tag (merge-change, …) suffixes and all production shapes, and fail-open on unparseable tags.
A `recheck-review` trigger on a real-finding BLOCK must post a refusal reply with no label writes, emit RETRIGGER_REFUSED, and neither reset the retry budget nor enqueue a review.
The bot's own comments and comments lacking the `recheck-review` token must be silent no-ops.
The `/rerun` operator endpoint must reset the per-revision retry budget before enqueueing, harmonizing with the bounded escalation from ticket 0347.
Gerrit comment-reply must use POST with message-only JSON body, never including a labels key, to avoid vote displacement.
